I've been using the Clarins Bright Plus Advanced Dark Spot Targeting Serum and I'm really happy with it so far. Even though I don't have too many dark spots, I've noticed my skin looks fresher and brighter overall. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky, which makes it easy to use both in the morning and at night. Since I don't struggle much with spots, I also tried it on my hands to see how it works there, and it felt nice — very hydrating and smoothing. Results may be more noticeable if you have stronger pigmentation or more dark spots. This serum feels lovely on the skin and adds brightness and evenness. For me, it's more of a preventative product than a corrective one, but I still enjoy the effect and the way it makes my skin look and feel.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Clarins Dark Spot Targeting Serum for a few weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed with the results so far. My skin tone looks more even, and some of the darker spots from past breakouts and sun exposure have started to fade noticeably. It has a lightweight, silky texture that absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, and it layers well with my other skincare products. The scent is light and pleasant—typical of Clarins products—and it didn't irritate my sensitive skin, which is a big plus. I appreciate that it's plant-based and formulated with ingredients like acerola and organic sea lily, which feel gentle yet effective. The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is the price point—it's definitely on the higher end. But if you're looking for a high-quality serum that actually targets dark spots and brightens your complexion, this is a great investment.

I received the Clarins Bright Plus Brightening Vitamin C & Niacinamide Dark Spot Serum, the newest launch from Clarins, complimentary in exchange for my honest review. All opinions are entirely my own. First off, I really appreciate Clarins' commitment to clean beauty and sustainability. This vegan serum is crafted with 91% natural ingredients and comes in elegant, eco-conscious packaging. As someone with dry skin, my biggest skincare concern is hyperpigmentation from past sun damage (thank you, tanning beds). I also struggle with dehydration, dullness, and early signs of aging—so I was excited to try this serum. It combines vitamin C, niacinamide, and Clarins' proprietary Evenness Technology to target dark spots and improve skin tone. The serum itself feels luxurious: lightweight, milky in texture, with a clean, subtle scent. My skin felt instantly soothed and hydrated—no greasiness, no sticky residue. It layers beautifully with other skincare products without pilling. One note: while I enjoy this product and the visible improvement in my skin's texture and tone, I do hope Clarins reconsiders its stance on animal testing for certain global markets in the near future. That said, I've noticed a real difference. My complexion looks smoother, more radiant, and evenly toned. I've even received compliments on my skin. I'll definitely continue using it and look forward to further fading of dark spots over time. Bottom Line: This serum delivers on its promises. Highly recommend it f
